sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:1

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:1:1
items.html: At the first time of each and every Zivug [coupling], etc.: That is, at the time of the exit of every Partzuf from the root of Atzilut, in the manner of the descent of every lower one from its upper one, as written in the previous parts — that it comes from the force of the refinement of the screen and its ascent to the Rosh, as is known — and from this aspect comes out the Katnut of every Partzuf, and this is called the first coupling for the emanation of the Partzuf. And it is known that afterwards it again rises to MAN [Mayin Nukvin] for the coupling of the Gadlut, to attain the Mochin, and this is called the second coupling.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:1:2
items.html: The male alone would awaken of itself to the Zivug, etc.: For every lower one is emanated and comes out through the coupling of the Rosh of its upper one, from within the inclusion of the screen and the records of the lower one in the coupling which is there; and there is here no matter of a coupling of male and female, as written in the Partzufim of AK, but it is considered like an aspect of the male alone. For the order of this coupling comes from the aspect of the striking of the upper light upon the screen, that according to the measure of its coarseness, so is the stature of the direct light and the reflected light, as is known — without MAN [Mayin Nukvin] and without the partnership of male and female, but everything depends on the coarseness of the screen, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:1:3
items.html: Distinct recognition of a Nukva [female] in particular, except from Ima onward: For the whole matter of the Nukva comes from the force of the restriction that was made upon Malchut; and therefore, in the Partzufim of AK, there is no aspect of a Nukva recognized in all the nine first Sefirot. But from Nekudim onward, where the second restriction was made there in the secret of the bottom Hey in the Nikvey Einayim, when the bottom Hey was joined with the bottom Rosh, in the secret of “and the two of them went” — then Bina descended to the degree of Malchut and received into itself the aspect of the restriction, which was before only in Malchut. For this reason, Bina and ZON came out outside of the entire RTS [Rosh-Toch-Sof], for the AHP of the Rosh descended and became the aspect of Guf and Toch; and Bina and ZON of the ten Sefirot of the Toch descended and became the aspect of the ten Sefirot of the end of the Partzuf; and Bina and ZON of the ten Sefirot of the end of the Partzuf came out entirely outside of Atzilut, like the Malchut of the first restriction, in which the line of Ein Sof concluded. Except that afterwards the three worlds of BYA were corrected in these Bina and ZON, as is known. And you see, that even after the second restriction, the existence of the restriction begins only from Bina onward, which is Ima, but not at all from above her. And this is what he said: “that there is no distinct recognition of a Nukva in particular, except from Ima onward.” And you must remember here, that the restriction mentioned in the place of Bina was not made but in the ZAT of Bina, and the GAR [first three] of Bina are not included in this restriction, as written in the previous parts.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:1:4
items.html: Of itself the MAN rose to be corrected, without anyone raising it — this is the meaning of the words Kad Salik beRe'uta: For after the screen of the Guf of Nekudim was refined from all its coarseness, and became equal to the aspect of the coarseness of the Rosh, it was then discerned, that it rose and was united with the screen of the Rosh, and was included with it in the coupling of the Rosh. For the equivalence of form joins the spirituals into one, as is known; and it is found that the screen and all the records included in it rose by themselves to the Rosh of SAG of AK, without anyone raising them (as above, Part 8, item 2, the passage beginning “Returned”). And then came out the stature of the Katnut of the Partzuf of Atik, as written there. And it is called the first coupling of Atik.
